observation: Diagnosis from src/render/bolusCanal.js + src/render/bolusView.js: the illegibility is geometric first, material/lighting second -- not ambient-cue-by-design. ribRings() built each of the 19 canal hoops via ringPart() as a FLAT annulus in the XY plane: zero z-thickness, only a 10 WU radial band, spaced 200 WU apart along the canal axis. Overhead/chase views see it edge-on (collapses to a line) and at range the interior fog/palette swallows it. Compounding: rib albedo 0x4a2420 sits inside the flesh palette (bank 0x3a0c10, shelf 0x4a1014, villus 0x5a2028), roughness 0.92, and the five lantern point lights sit at x=-560 with range 180 while the rings at x~0 are ~560 WU away -- outside every shaft's range, so the hoops were lit only by ambient 0.16 + key/fill. Fix (smallest coherent set): (1) ringPart() gained tube/depth params and an extruded-band path (inner/outer radius x front/back z, double-walled); ribs now use a 16 WU band x 30 WU depth so they hold silhouette edge-on and face-on. (2) rib albedo lifted 0x4a2420->0x54302a with a restrained warm self-glow (emissive 0x8a4a30, intensity 0.55) carried on the part and honored by meshFromPart() in bolusView.js -- same emissiveIntensity convention bolusSilhouettes.js already uses. Density, radius, z-spacing, canal mood, and the lantern rig are unchanged; ribRadial crest/stall animation is unaffected (it displaces x/y radially and preserves z). Captured via the exact positioned route (game-lock + sector-shots, --x=0 --z=-1300 --t=4) into bolusrib-fix-20261117/. Pixel check vs the pre-fix positioned capture at the same aim: warm-ember pixels rose ~65x (529 -> 34,274) and concentrate in a ~500 px-wide horizontal band across the tract at rows ~261-268 -- a readable hoop crossing the canal, vs scattered noise before.
decision: Readability fix applied at builder source and captured through the ordinary positioned route; final visual acceptance belongs to the orchestrator.
next: Orchestrator visual acceptance of bolusrib-fix-20261117/sector_the_bolus.png. If the ember reads too hot in motion, emissiveIntensity 0.55 is the single tuning knob; geometry depth/band are the structural fix.
performance: rib vertex count per hoop rose 32->64 (19 hoops, ~600 extra verts total); ribRadial buffer-skip logic unchanged -- still uploads only on crest/stall pose changes (bolus-rib-upload test passes).
